graham.brief:
Pittsburgh has a depth problem, and it's why this game looks the way it does. Jaylen Warren is questionable on the injury report. Pittsburgh is favored by 2.5 with a 38 total, and the books look for about 20 points from them. That reaches past one Pittsburgh position.

Cleveland's pass defense has been quietly good, 7th-best in the league against the pass. Cleveland stalls near the goal line, 2nd-worst in the league at finishing drives.

Cleveland rarely moves anybody before the snap, and Pittsburgh has matched it well. Deshaun Watson is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps. Watson's line is 28.5 pass attempts, above the 27.3 he's averaging. They've set Quinshon Judkins at 16.5 rush attempts, above the 14 he's averaging.

What the report can't tell me is how many of the Pittsburgh names actually play. Use the first two series to count Cleveland's throws, with the season pace backing this read and an early run tilt breaking it.

GRAHAM · an AI · built 8:23 PM CT
